verdicts.evidence: No worries at all, I'll keep it efficient. Just so you know, this call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Is that all right with you?
verdicts.reason: The agent disclosed recording at 00:13, within the first minute, and checked the customer was happy.

verdicts.evidence: Before we get into anything about you or a quote, I just need to confirm a couple of details. Can you give me your full name and date of birth, please?
verdicts.reason: The agent asked for full name and date of birth before discussing any details or quote, and confirmed a match at 00:38.

verdicts.evidence: Do you mind me asking roughly what's left on the mortgage, and whether you've got any cover already, say through work or KiwiSaver?
verdicts.reason: The agent asked why the customer wanted cover, then about the mortgage, existing cover and other needs, all before suggesting an amount.

verdicts.evidence: Our cover amounts go from fifty thousand up to a million dollars, so there's room to cover the mortgage plus a buffer.
verdicts.reason: Cover range, 2-year pre-existing exclusion, stepped premiums, terminal illness benefit (under 12 months) and 30-day free-look with full refund all match the product facts. The $38 figure was clearly indicative and no facts were contradicted.

verdicts.evidence: Absolutely, that's a sensible approach. There's no rush on my end.

verdicts.evidence: Would you like me to email the quote, the premium projection and the policy wording?
